title: Coordinated rollout and sample matrix for SDK/API v2: streaming, function-calling, structured-output
creator: Ava Patel
description: Orchestrate cross-team launch for SDK and API surface v2 focusing on three capabilities: streaming responses, structured-output (schema-driven), and function-calling. Deliver language SDK samples (Python, JS, Go), updated REST snippets, release notes, and a canary rollout plan that minimizes customer disruptions while enabling telemetry collection for regressions.
acceptance_criteria: SDK packages published to internal artifact registry and public registries (npm, pypi, go proxy)
Docs pages for streaming, structured-output, and function calling published and linked from SDK README
Sample matrix covering 9 canonical scenarios across three languages available in examples repo
Staging canary runs at 5% traffic for 48h with no regression alerts before 25% ramp
Release notes draft reviewed and signed off by Eng, Docs, and Legal
Rollback playbook and automated monitoring runbooks in Console prepared
checklist: Finalize sample matrix and map to example repo paths
Lock API contract and update OpenAPI spec
Create PRs for SDKs and link to this ticket
Docs draft + code snippets added to staging site
QA smoke tests for latency and correctness per scenario
Define canary traffic ramp and rollback thresholds
Schedule cross-functional launch dry run (Engineering, Docs, Support, Marketing)
Prepare release-notes short/long forms and migration guidance

2026-03-06: Legal flagged data-retention language for private deployments; Docs to include KMS/HSM callouts
2026-03-08: Prototype sample mapping completed: 9 scenarios x 3 langs -> 27 examples. Some streaming edge cases need extra asserts (ENG-8573)

review_comments: Marcus Li (Eng): Add explicit tokenization note in Python streaming example — large messages may be chunked.
Sofia Ramirez (Docs): Suggest breaking structured-output guide into 'basic' and 'advanced' pages to reduce cognitive load.
Noah Kim (QA): Need deterministic tests for function-calling ordering to catch flaky race conditions.
Tariq Hassan (Security): Ensure examples do not include any real keys; add placeholder pattern and link to KMS integration doc.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Streaming semantics differ slightly between SDKs -> Mitigation: add cross-language conformance tests and runtime linters
Risk: Structured-output regressions in nested schemas -> Mitigation: include schema-driven unit tests and example golden outputs
Risk: Canary telemetry thresholds too loose -> Mitigation: conservative rollout (5% -> 25% -> 50%) with automated rollback on error-rate/latency breaches
Risk: Docs not localized -> Mitigation: ship English docs first and mark localization scope for next sprint; communicate to marketing
release_notes_draft: Short: SDK/API v2 introduces streaming responses, schema-driven structured output, and first-class function-calling examples across Python, JS, and Go. Improved ergonomics and sample coverage to help you ship robust integrations faster.
Whatchanged: Added streaming iterate() helpers in SDKs; introduced 'schema' param for structured responses; standardized function-calling payloads and examples.
Migration: See migration guide in docs for breaking changes (minor request/response shape updates).
Known issues: JS streaming on Node 12 shows higher memory usage in long-run tests — recommend Node 14+ for production until ENG-8722 is fixed.
